name: connected-knowledge
description: Turn AI chats, coding sessions and documents into sourced, linked Obsidian notes.

interface.shortDescription: Collect sources and develop connected knowledge
defaultPrompt: Use $ck-setup to set up Connected Knowledge on this machine.
Use $ck-help to show what I can do next.
Use $ck-add-session to save this session to my vault.
interface.longDescription: Set up or adopt an Obsidian vault, save Codex and Claude Code sessions as labelled conversation notes with transcripts, and develop sourced, linked knowledge. Commands: $ck-setup, $ck-help, $ck-add-session. Capture stays off until you switch it on; machine state stays outside the vault.
